crime: During free time, {WITCH_NAME}'s planning partner wrote a simple plan for their next afternoon together. The partner chose the activities and gained a companion who always followed; {WITCH_NAME} never had to decide. One day at a recreation-room table, with the partner's roommate beside them, {WITCH_NAME} took the pencil in her left hand and wrote that she wanted to visit the lake. The partner took the pencil in her right hand, crossed out the lake, replaced it with the recreation room, and said she would keep deciding for both of them because {WITCH_NAME} always hesitated.

That evening, the roommate saw the partner enter the library and saw {WITCH_NAME} follow soon afterward. Several minutes later, {WITCH_NAME} returned alone and handed over a folded note written in pencil. Its letters matched the partner's handwriting exactly. She said the partner had written it and wanted to remain alone in the library until lockup.

Near lockup, the roommate found the partner strangled in the library. A thread from {WITCH_NAME}'s left cuff was caught under the partner's fingernails, and the same cuff had a fresh tear. Graphite streaks ran from the written lines toward the note's right edge.

Borrowed Handwriting changes letter forms, not the hand moving the pencil. At the recreation-room table, the roommate had watched the partner write with her right hand, but {WITCH_NAME}, who later brought the note, used her left. The rightward graphite streaks therefore showed that {WITCH_NAME} had written the note. The thread under the partner's fingernails matched the fresh tear in {WITCH_NAME}'s left cuff and proved they had struggled during the strangulation. {WITCH_NAME} had strangled the partner, whose hand tore the cuff while resisting, then used the handwriting sample she had touched at the recreation-room table to forge the request for solitude. {WITCH_NAME} never noticed the thread.
fields.epitaph: Her last motion belonged to another hand.
execution: A single giant iron hand closes around her standing torso, pinning both arms to her sides. It lifts her and carries her away on its own.
Its fingers tighten across her chest and back. Her ribs and spine break, and her chest collapses. The hand remains closed until her chest stops moving.

magic.name: Borrowed Handwriting
magic.text: After touching a sample written by one person, she can make her next short message appear in that person's handwriting.
